# Using Art Director in Kiro

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to Kiro.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.kiro/skills/artdirector/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.kiro/skills/artdirector/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness kiro --skill artdirector
node packages/cli install --harness kiro --skill artdirector --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. Kiro loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also run it explicitly by typing `/artdirector`.

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.kiro/skills/artdirector` for a project install, or `~/.kiro/skills/artdirector` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Ask the agent which skills it has loaded and check that `artdirector` is listed.

## Notes

- Workspace skills take priority over user skills with the same name.
- This skill drives the packages/artdirector engine. Build it once, and set ARTDIRECTOR_HOME to its folder if you copied the skill folder by hand instead of using the install command.
- Documentation: [Kiro](https://kiro.dev/docs/skills/) (path source: official).
